coaching.loss.Fire: Includes smoke, soot, protein fires. If water was used to extinguish, add Water as secondary.
coaching.loss.Water: Verify coverage for groundwater, flood, and sump pump failure — these are often excluded or capped.
coaching.loss.Mold: Usually has coverage limits. Mold from covered water damage is typically covered in full under water coverage.
coaching.loss.Dust/Debris: From construction or remediation (flood cuts, charred material). Common secondary contaminant.
coaching.loss.Puffback: Furnace/fireplace malfunction pushes soot or oily residue into the home. No flames.
coaching.loss.Oil: Heating oil spill/mist. Requires dry cleaning only — washing won't work. May need to replace non-dry-cleanable items.
coaching.loss.Unknown: Cause of loss is not yet determined. No sub-type options — update once identified.
coaching.loss.Other: Windstorms, fallen trees, etc. — perils that don't fit other categories.
coaching.loss.Non-Restoration: Not an insurance claim — regular residential or commercial cleaning unrelated to a loss event.
coaching.role.Policyholder: The person(s) named on the policy who is required to sign our authorization paperwork.
coaching.role.Primary: The primary contact handling our portion of the project. May or may not be the policyholder or owner — can be a PA, employee, or family member.
coaching.role.Referral: The first person that called us with the order. When assigned, we have the go-ahead to begin. Note: some referrers may only be giving us a lead.
coaching.role.ExpertStainRemoval: A per-hour charge for removing complicated loss-related stains from items worth saving.
coaching.role.FindAddress: Use Google to insert a valid, verified address.
coaching.group.LTFD: Long Term Final Delivery (greater than 1 month)
coaching.group.TLI: Total Loss Inventory of non-salvageable items
coaching.group.Test: Test cleaning to determine scope (results needed ASAP)
coaching.group.Dispose: Items that will not be returned
coaching.group.Storage Only: Items that will be stored and returned without cleaning
coaching.service.Appliance: Large items requiring specialized handling (refrigerators, ranges, etc.).
coaching.service.TLI: Total Loss Inventory - listing/valuing non-restorable items.
coaching.section.interview: Ask the customer these questions during or before the initial visit.
coaching.section.timeline: Plan pickups, rush deliveries, in-home events, and final delivery based on the repair schedule and living situation.
coaching.section.eventInstructions: What scheduling and field team need to know — conditions, access, customer preferences, what to bring.
coaching.section.repairs: Repair type determines your delivery timeline and potential blockers. Each option auto-suggests a delivery group and adds delivery instructions.
coaching.section.rush: Rush deliveries get essentials (clothing, bedding, toiletries) to the customer within days. The delivery address will auto-link to their first living situation.
coaching.section.planner: Select delivery groups and assign dates/addresses. One group must be the Final (F) delivery — this determines storage duration.
coaching.section.finalWarning: One group should be marked as Final (F) — this determines storage duration.
coaching.section.stayingHome: Customer is staying in the home. Deliveries will be made to the primary address. Consider a Rush Final Delivery (RFD) if everything can be rushed.
coaching.section.addHome: Add "Their Home" as the last step to mark return after repairs.
coaching.section.events: Any travel or formal events during the repair period? We'll make sure the right items are pulled and delivered on time.
coaching.section.groups: Select the delivery groups that apply. These feed into the Rush Guide timeline.
coaching.field.orderName: Auto-generated from LastName-TownST. Lock to prevent changes.
coaching.field.lossType: Pick the primary peril — what happened first. Example: kitchen fire put out with water = Fire primary, Water secondary.
coaching.field.contaminants: e.g. Fire with water damage from firefighting, or water loss leading to mold. Incompatible types are grayed out.
coaching.field.severity: Typically entered after the site inspection, not during intake.
coaching.field.rejectScale: Severity reject scale: 1 = None, 2 = Possible, 3 = Many expected, 5 = Extreme.
coaching.field.contaminantLevels: Rate specific contaminant levels. 0 = None, 3 = Severe. Typically completed after the site inspection — not during intake.
coaching.field.qualityCode: Customer's quality standard. Q1 = Highest (designer/luxury items), Q5 = Basic (everyday items).
coaching.field.handlingCodes: Special processing instructions. Hover each code for its meaning.
coaching.field.referrer: The referrer reached out with this order. If assigned, we can begin. If only a lead, we cannot contact the customer yet.
coaching.field.isLead: A Lead requires selling the customer and getting approvals from the adjuster before we proceed. No billable charges yet — just an opportunity we will pursue.
coaching.field.isOrder: An Order is a confirmed project ready to be scheduled and worked.
coaching.step.1: Select the building type and access details for the property.
coaching.step.2: Set the property size — floors, bedrooms, and square footage.
coaching.step.3: Confirm rooms and mark affected areas.
coaching.step.4: Set severity, handling codes, and instructions per room.

blockerRules.trigger: Insurance company set to Not Yet Known

Still Wet.coaching: We will need to get out right away, separate the wet items by color and process them immediately using an anti-microbial to prevent mold growth.

Visible Mold.coaching: Please don't disturb the mold and consider wearing safety gear. If your Insurance is considering this a 'Mold Claim' it may count against your mold limit.

Structural Damage.coaching: Please stay out of any unstable areas. Has there been a safety assessment?

No Electricity.coaching: No problem, our crew will bring portable lights. Will you be able to pull your Rush items?

Boarded Up.coaching: Please confirm safe entry and available access.

Just Cleaning.coaching: Timeline: 1-2 weeks. Customer may stay home or be out briefly. Plan essentials for a quick turnaround — Rush Final Delivery (RFD) where everything goes back at once.

actions.value: Repairs: Cleaning only — quick turnaround expected

Paint.coaching: Timeline: 2-4 weeks. Customer likely out 1-2 weeks for painting + 48hr cure. Consider a Short Term Delivery (STD) — verify hardware is back up and walls are ready before re-hanging window treatments.

actions.value: Repairs: Painting scheduled — note window treatments and wall-hung items
Repairs: Painting in progress — note items near walls, window treatments, and hardware for removal

Refinish Floors.coaching: Timeline: 3-6 weeks. Customer out while floors cure — plan Short Term Delivery (STD). Follow contractor's advice on cure times before placing heavy furniture.

actions.value: Repairs: Floor refinishing — use protective coverings during pickup, note heavy furniture placement

Replace Floors.coaching: Timeline: 1-3 months. Customer likely out for extended period — plan Long Term Delivery (LTD). New floors need full cure before heavy furniture.

actions.value: Repairs: Floor replacement — use protective coverings during pickup, note heavy furniture placement

Cosmetic Damage.coaching: Timeline: 2-6 weeks. Customer may be out a few weeks for minor repairs (cabinets, tile, cosmetic). Plan Long Term Delivery (LTD) — confirm all repairs complete before scheduling final.

actions.value: Repairs: Cosmetic work in progress — note items near repair areas

Major Structural Damage.coaching: Timeline: 3-9+ months. Customer will be out for an extended period — plan Long Term Delivery (LTD) with long-term storage. Coordinate with contractor for a completion estimate.

Complete Rebuild.coaching: Timeline: 6-12+ months. Customer out until certificate of occupancy — plan Long Term Final Delivery (LTFD) with long-term storage. Coordinate with contractor for phased delivery if possible.

Staying in home.coaching: We'll try to work as quietly as possible and expedite your household essentials like bedding, shower curtains and throw rugs. We also have temporary shades if you need privacy on the windows.

Hotel.coaching: We can deliver your rush items straight to the hotel.

Temp.coaching: We can deliver future seasonal items to this address.

Rental.coaching: We can deliver future seasonal items to this address.

Neighbor.coaching: We can coordinate delivery to their neighbor's address.

Relative.coaching: We can coordinate delivery to the family member's address.

Moving.coaching: We'll update your file so your final delivery goes smoothly to your new permanent address. Will you be moving locally or will we need to coordinate a national move?

No Packout.coaching: Confirm with the customer — are they certain nothing needs to come out for cleaning?

Content Manipulation.coaching: Our team will move and protect items in-place during repairs. No items will leave the home.

Partial Packout.coaching: We'll pack out only the affected areas. Which rooms are being packed?

Full Packout.coaching: We'll pack the entire home for full restoration. This is a major project.

Deliver ASAP.coaching: We will prioritize your most important items to get your house feeling like home again as fast as possible.

Deliver to Temp.coaching: We'll coordinate with you to deliver exactly what you need to your temporary residence.

Deliver to New Home.coaching: We will hold onto everything safely and deliver it straight to your new place when you are ready to move in.

Long-Term Storage.coaching: We can provide safe, secure, long term storage until your home is ready.

Rugs.coaching: Ask about size, weight and heavy furniture that may need to be moved. We may need extra manpower.

Window Treatments.coaching: Our team will carefully take down your drapes and blinds for specialized cleaning. Will we need any special ladders or equipment?

Clothing.coaching: We'll kindly ask that you prioritize your rush items.

Furniture.coaching: We'll bring plenty of moving blankets and padding to protect the corners and surfaces of your furniture.

Art.coaching: We'll use specialized picture boxes and packing paper to keep your artwork completely safe.

Electronics.coaching: Consider any rush electronics we may need.

Appliances.coaching: We will send heavy-duty dollies and extra hands to safely move your large appliances.

Pregnancy.coaching: We will use baby-safe, hypoallergenic cleaning methods.

Baby.coaching: We will use baby-safe, hypoallergenic cleaning methods and can rush essential baby items like cribs, strollers, and clothing.

Respiratory Concerns.coaching: We will strictly use mild, fragrance-free cleaning agents to protect your respiratory health.

Premium Brands.coaching: We will route your high-end designer pieces for delicate hand-cleaning.

Skin Sensitivity.coaching: We will process your garments using 100% dye-free and fragrance-free detergents.

Pets.coaching: Please make sure your pets are secured in a safe room. I'll remind the crew to be very careful with open doors.

actions.value: Keep doors closed - pets on site

Medical Yes.coaching: We'll make a note for the crew to be aware of medical conditions in the household.

Allergies Yes.coaching: We will use hypoallergenic, fragrance-free cleaning products.

SelfClean Yes.coaching: We'll set aside those items and return them uncleaned as requested.

Air-Dry.coaching: We'll air-dry all launderable items — no machine drying.

Low Heat.coaching: We'll use low heat settings only on all items.

Storage Yes.coaching: We'll arrange safe, climate-controlled storage at our facility.
